svg.desc: Driven TFIM3 snapshot 2026-09-25, operator-error target 1e-06. Wei–Norman: 32 actual emitted CX gates; Magnus4: 512 actual emitted CX gates; Fer4: 1024 actual emitted CX gates; Midpoint-S2: 4100 actual emitted CX gates. All outputs passed. A linear scale begins at zero. One three-qubit target, not a universal ranking; step-grid settings need not be minimal. Same native-ladder and eligible native-frame portfolio. Source: docs/driven_benchmark.txt. Regenerate: python docs/figures/generate.py.
